test_dataset_erm: test that ERM algorithm completes one training step on a given dataset without raising an error
test_num_environments: test that num_environments returns the correct count of environments for a given dataset name
test_make_minibatches: test the helpers make_minibatches function to create minibatch arrays from a dataset for algorithm updates
test_get_dataset_class: test that get_dataset_class returns the correct dataset class for a given dataset name string
test_algorithm_update: test that an ERM algorithm instance can successfully call update with minibatches on a dataset
